title: Revelation: the Lamb on the throne
note: Rebuilt on 2026-11-26 from the Bible Explorer film of the same slug. New wording, same facts: each claim is in the old film's captions or its 'differ' note, whose sources are in docs/work/elite/explorer-ledger.md. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, checked against client/public/bible/text/ by film/tools/write-script.py.

lines: Revelation is the last book of the Bible. Its title means an unveiling.
It was written to real churches under real pressure, some in danger, some comfortable and compromised. It shows them their world as heaven sees it.
Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.

scripture.text: Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last

lines: John sees the risen Christ and receives messages for seven churches. Then a door opens in heaven: God's throne, and a Lamb who opens a sealed scroll.
A sequence of visions follows, and the book ends with a new heaven and a new earth.

scripture.text: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy

lines: The throne is the book's central image. Whatever chaos appears on earth, the vision of chapter four shows the One seated on the throne, worshiped day and night.
The empires that claim ultimate power are not ultimate.

scripture.text: Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!

lines: John hears of the Lion of the tribe of Judah. He looks, and sees a Lamb who was slain. That reversal defines the book.
Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain.
Christ conquers by sacrifice, and his people overcome the same way.

scripture.text: Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain

lines: Readers follow four main approaches. Some read most of it as fulfilled in the first centuries. Some as a map of church history. Some as events still to come. Some as the conflict of every age.
Many combine them, and faithful Christians hold each. This film takes no side and names no date.

scripture.text: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints

lines: Revelation doesn't flinch from judgment on evil, but it doesn't end there. The goal is a renewed creation in which God dwells with his people, death is gone, and the nations walk in the light of the Lamb.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

scripture.text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes

lines: Start with chapter one. The key chapters are one, two, five, twelve, thirteen, twenty, twenty-one, and twenty-two.
Read its symbols by the Old Testament. The book's own interest is less in timetables than in worship, endurance, and hope.
